entities.name: Andrés Schneiter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrés Schneiter is an Argentine tennis coach and a former professional player. His career-high ATP singles ranking was world No. 219 in 1998 and No. 62 in doubles in 2003. He is currently coaching Daniel Vallejo.
